review_basis:
A genuinely fresh real project (CP25028, MSU Union Sparty Store Renovations, Michigan State University), pulled from the corpus_2 GitHub Release during a seventh batch-survey pass (also covering 075_MT, 077_MT, 080_CA, 100_OH -- 077_MT's own M4.0 sheet was swept first but its round/rect labels only yielded trivially short 0.19-0.25 LF fragments, not pursued). Screened for image coverage first per Run 86's own established check: `imgRatio` reads 0.00 on this sheet, real vector CAD.

This project's own labeling convention prefixes equipment TAGS with `X-` throughout (`X-FCU-5`, `X-TU-10`, `X-SD`, `X-RG`) -- a real, existing-equipment naming convention distinct from a size-label prefix, and one that does not touch the bare `N"ø` size callouts themselves, so no grammar change was needed here. A grid sweep of sixteen bare round-duct labels found a real, clean 4.68 LF `14"ø` round duct: `size:{kind:round,d_in:14}`, confidence 0. A marked crop confirms it visually: a real thin flexible-duct connector (drawn single-line, thinner than the double-line main trunk visible elsewhere in the same crop, a normal convention for flex-duct takeoffs) running from a real fan coil unit's own discharge connection (X-FCU-5, fed by a `28"x12" SA` trunk) through two real elbows to a real supply diffuser connection (tagged X-SD, 300 CFM, `14"ø` per its own schedule table printed directly beside it). Both stops are real: a `dead_end` at the FCU discharge, an `ambiguous` stop at the diffuser's own multi-candidate connection box. `resolveRunSegments` reproduces the identical three-segment path (2.23 + 0.33 + 2.12 = 4.68 LF) and a reseed `trace_run` using the exact `bench:linear`-style seed (`seedOnLongestSegment`, standard practice since Run 95) against the freshly re-loaded, already-committed raw PDF reproduces identical points, length, and size exactly.

A second, visually similar thin flex-duct candidate on the companion M-300 sheet (page 15, a `10"ø` connector from a different diffuser tagged X-SD to a similar fan-coil-style symbol) was swept but not pursued further this pass, to avoid two very similar goldens from the same small project in one sitting.
scope: A single real 14-inch round flexible-duct connector segment (4.68 LF) on the Sparty Store renovation project's own mechanical plan, sheet M-400, from a real fan coil unit's own discharge connection (X-FCU-5) through two real elbows to a real supply diffuser connection (X-SD, 300 CFM). Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the `28"x12" SA` trunk duct feeding the fan coil unit; the similar `10"ø` flex-duct candidate noted in review_basis on the companion M-300 sheet, not authored; every other one of the real duct-size callouts found on this same sheet, not attempted this pass; every other sheet on this real 25-sheet plan set.

runs.description: 14-inch round flexible-duct connector, from a real fan coil unit's discharge to a real supply diffuser connection.
